decisions.tier_rule: Tier 3 by the path-glob table: the work touches Makefile and DB/data-shaped behaviour (src/seed/, tour beat selection), which outrank the Tier 2 rows for src/api/routes/, src/tour/ and frontend/. Tier 3 => skeptic panel P=3, acceptance runs, real-browser proof, human sign-off.
decisions.slice: Make `make workbench` reach a rendered, real-Opus Paris tour on a NORMAL DIRTY working tree, fixing each blocker at its root. Four blockers stand in series between the command and the tour; a fifth would have corrupted the demo artifact itself.
decisions.D1_port_kill: scripts/workbench.sh:26 runs `lsof -ti:8000 | xargs kill`. `lsof -i:8000` matches the REMOTE port and includes CLOSED sockets. MEASURED: it currently returns PID 62717 = the user's Claude desktop app (two CLOSED sockets 127.0.0.1:5444x->127.0.0.1:8000). `lsof -tiTCP:8000 -sTCP:LISTEN` returns empty, and still returns 1404 for a real listener. Same defect at scripts/workbench.sh:68 (advice string handed to the human), scripts/deploy.py:84, Makefile:364.
decisions.D2_seed_fork_root_cause: NOT stale drift. src/seed/locations.py:43 hard-codes "Café de Flore" and _MERGE_POI keys on `MERGE (p:POI {name,city_name})` — the literal display name. data/paris/poi-raw.json has the unaccented "Cafe de Flore" and no accented entry; canonical_name_key (src/api/models/nodes.py:25-33) does not fold accents. So seed_pois FORKS a 371st node on EVERY run: ensure_dev_data creates the drift it then dies on. `make db-reset DB=dev` does NOT fix it — this is a deterministic committed-source contradiction on any machine.
decisions.D3_two_shields_in_series: JUDGE CORRECTION to the planner. `make workbench` does NOT die at the parity check. It dies EARLIER, at scripts/deploy.py:117: ensure_dev_data:56 parity fails -> :61 src.main -> :63 loop sorted london,new_york,paris -> new_york has 37 areas -> _upload_areas_step -> _port_busy(8000) is a false positive from the SAME lsof ghost -> sys.exit. Shield A = deploy.py:117 (removed by S2). Shield B = ensure_dev_data.py:69 final parity (removed by S4). S1 must land FIRST because it deletes the kill before EITHER shield falls.
decisions.D4_placeholder_beats: THE FINDING THAT WOULD HAVE WRECKED THE DEMO. MEASURED on the live dev graph: Eiffel Tower and Shakespeare and Company each carry an `active` NarrativeBeat with beat_id NULL and audio_url s3://ondoway-audio/placeholder/*.mp3 (plus 2 on the Café de Flore fork). LOAD_PARIS_BEATS_CYPHER (src/tour/selection.py:604) filters ONLY on active_status='active'; `grep -rn "beat_id IS NOT NULL" src/` returns ZERO. Both db_parity.py:112 and prune_orphan_pois.py:48 DO filter beat_id IS NOT NULL, so parity and prune are structurally blind to them. Placeholder audio can therefore land at the Eiffel Tower in the very tour being demoed. S3 must precede S4: after the rename those 2 beats MERGE onto the REAL Cafe de Flore POI, where they become invisible to parity AND to prune — permanent.
decisions.S4_dropped_autoprune: JUDGE RULING: the planner's S4 (wire `prune_orphan_pois --apply` into ensure_dev_data) is REJECTED. `_ensure-dev-data` is a prerequisite of 30+ Make targets including api, workbench, dashboard, flutter-ios, _test-python, _test-golden, _test-grade, _test-invariants and test-live. That would put a DETACH DELETE against the shared 7687 graph into essentially every developer command, on a repo where sibling sessions share containers. _MAX_ORPHAN_ABSOLUTE=20 means up to 20 POIs deleted with no operator in the loop, and a genuine repo-side deletion is indistinguishable from the seed fork. Replaced by a ONE-TIME, HUMAN-GATED `make prune-orphans CITY=paris` dry-run -> read -> APPLY=1. S3 alone makes the system convergent.
decisions.S8_dropped_offline_executor: JUDGE RULING: the planner's S8 (get_premium_compose_executor falls back to OfflinePremiumExecutor) is REJECTED as a repeat of a named catastrophe. src/tour/premium_tour.py:394 says verbatim 'never selected by product code', and memory `never-mock-in-workbench` records that wiring mock as the workbench default and calling it Opus is the specific lie that destroyed trust. It is also strictly WORSE than today: a missing paid flag currently raises RuntimeError loudly, whereas S8 would silently serve fabricated offline-{n} content, with only tests/test_render_manifest.py:147 between it and shipping fake tours. It also buys nothing — the subprocess is already $0. REPLACED by S9: pin "ONDOWAY_ENABLE_PAID_LLM_CALLS": "0" in the test subprocess env dict.
decisions.build_identity_synthesis: PO ruled (ii) an explicit local allowance; Planner ruled (i) export GIT_COMMIT_SHA in workbench.sh. JUDGE: both objections are partly false. BuildFingerprint IS pattern-locked (src/tour/artifact.py:421 `^[0-9a-f]{40}$`, frozen, extra=forbid) so no sentinel fits THERE — but PremiumBuildIdentity (src/tour/premium_tour.py:502-507) is a plain frozen dataclass with no validation, where a `local_dirty_tree: bool` is trivially representable. And GIT_COMMIT_SHA's own error string at :514 calls it 'deployment commit fingerprint', so option (i) is a semantic lie in a process-wide env var. ADOPTED SYNTHESIS: leave resolve_build_identity's deploy path untouched; add a separately-named local opt-in ONDOWAY_ALLOW_DIRTY_LOCAL_BUILD=1 (mirroring the existing ONDOWAY_ALLOW_INSECURE_AUTH_SECRETS idiom already at scripts/workbench.sh:34) that fills commit_sha from HEAD and sets local_dirty_tree=True; RAISE if RENDER_GIT_COMMIT is set so it can never fire on Render; surface it on the response and render a banner.
decisions.no_new_artifacts: Per the user's hard constraint, every step repairs an EXISTING resource. Proven-not-new: scripts/prune_orphan_pois.py already exists (wired to make prune-orphans, Makefile:424) with dry-run default, _MAX_ORPHAN_FRACTION/_ABSOLUTE caps, local-target assert and DETACH DELETE; CandidateRejectionCode is an existing enum (src/tour/candidate_eligibility.py:17-24) whose 7 members provably lack a build-fingerprint case; logging.getLogger("ondoway.api") is the existing convention (src/api/dependencies.py:39); _RaisingPremiumExecutor already exists (tests/test_trips_spend_and_authz.py:74); tests/test_data_integrity.py already exists FOR THIS DEFECT CLASS (its docstring names accent-duplicate POIs); the tmp-git-repo test pattern already exists (tests/test_beat_migration.py:58).
decisions.flake_trap: Any test touching resolve_build_identity must drive a TEMPORARY git repo (monkeypatch REPO_ROOT) and assert BOTH branches. A test calling it against the live REPO_ROOT passes only while this repo is dirty and inverts when clean.
decisions.out_of_scope: No change to BuildFingerprint's field set (certification replay contract). No edits to data/*/poi-raw.json, areas.json or any beat corpus (AC-9 is the anti-cheat). No Aura/cloud/deploy action. No tour-quality work. No New York or London browser proof. OfflinePremiumExecutor stays out of product code.
decisions.human_run_acceptance_out_of_engine_scope: EXPLICITLY OUT OF ENGINE SCOPE (presented to and approved by the human before execution). These are NOT abandoned — they are the terminal deliverable, executed by the main agent WITH the human, because none is expressible as a `make test-file` pytest node id and the engine's test_command rule therefore cannot carry them. AC-10 needs a real `make workbench` launch; AC-19..AC-22 need the real paid Opus browser run (up to 8 authoring calls, ~$1, max 2 previews, second explicit human yes required first per AC-24); AC-25 is the run's close gate, which the engine performs once as `make audit` rather than as a step. Verbatim texts: AC-10: make workbench exits with the API healthy: curl -fs http://localhost:8000/api/v1/healthz returns 200 and /tmp/ondoway-workbench-api.log contains no traceback. | AC-19: Given a freshly launched make workbench on a DIRTY tree, when Paris + a start point + a duration are set and #tourGenerateBtn is clicked, then #tourStops renders >= 3 non-leg stops. Full-page screenshot required. | AC-20: Every non-leg stop shows non-empty narration and no two stops render byte-identical narration. At least two stops' narration legible in the screenshot. | AC-21: The response provider reflects the Anthropic executor, compose_status is 'composed', and the header shows the Premium label — not the basic lane and not 'offline'. | AC-22: The narration-quality and deterministic quality-rubric panels (rendered only on the non-basic branch, review.html:3451-3453) are visible in the screenshot — structural proof the Premium branch was taken. | AC-25: make lint is zero errors and make test passes. make test must not run concurrently with the browser session (shared containers).

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a uvicorn listening on 127.0.0.1:8000 and a separate process holding only a client connection to it, when the launcher's port-freeing step selects PIDs, then the set contains the listener PID and the listener is terminated.

Given the same fixture, when the port-freeing step runs, then the CLIENT process is still alive (ps -p exits 0). No process whose only :8000 socket is client-side/ESTABLISHED/CLOSED/TIME_WAIT is ever signalled.
Given Claude Helper PID 62717 holds two CLOSED client sockets to :8000, when make workbench runs to completion, then ps -p 62717 still exits 0. Capture lsof -i:8000 before and after.
Given only a client/CLOSED socket to :8000 exists, then scripts/deploy.py _port_busy(8000) returns False and _upload_areas_step proceeds past deploy.py:117.
Given the port-freeing step finds a process to kill, when it runs, then it prints the PID and command name before signalling. A silent kill fails this criterion.
make db-parity TARGET=local exits 0 with [OK] on POIs, beats, areas and POI->Area for all three cities.
Running scripts/ensure_dev_data.py TWICE consecutively exits 0 both times. A single green run does not satisfy this — the defect is that seeding re-creates the drift.
The dev graph has exactly 370 (:POI {city_name:'paris'}) nodes, exactly one with name_key 'cafe de flore', and zero with name_key 'café de flore'.
git diff --stat -- data/ is EMPTY. Parity was not achieved by editing committed corpus data.

Given a dirty tree and the local opt-in set, when POST /api/v1/trips/preview runs for Paris, then candidate_eligible is true and compose_status is 'composed'. Build identity is never the reason for a downgrade.
Given RENDER_GIT_COMMIT is set to a valid 40-hex SHA and the tree is dirty, the local dirty-tree allowance is NOT applied. The concession can never activate on Render.
git diff -- src/tour/artifact.py shows no change to the BuildFingerprint field set.

With a clean tree and no env override, resolve_build_identity() still returns HEAD and still rejects a malformed GIT_COMMIT_SHA. Both branches asserted against a TEMPORARY git repo, never the ambient tree.

Given the premium path inside preview_trip's try block raises for any reason, then a WARNING-or-higher record on the 'ondoway' namespace names the exception type and message, with exc_info set. Exactly one record per request.

An environment/config fault must NOT be reported as basic_tour.reason 'llm_generation_failed'. Two different causes must not produce byte-identical payloads; the build-fingerprint case yields code 'build_fingerprint_unavailable' and a detail containing the raised message.
grep -c candidate_rejection frontend/review.html is > 0, and in a real browser a preview returning candidate_eligible:false renders the code AND detail as visible text. Screenshot required.
AC-15/16/17 are provable with ZERO paid calls, using a pre-spend fault (resolve_build_identity runs at trips.py:1073, before _spend_precheck at :1074).
Given a start point with no tourable corpus nearby, the renderTourRefusal card renders a readable reason — not a blank #tourStops, not a stuck spinner, not a silent success with zero stops.

The acceptance run makes at most TWO live Paris previews (each up to 8 Opus calls). A per-run cost estimate is printed and explicitly approved by the human BEFORE any live preview. Report the actual call count and spend.

No beat with beat_id NULL and s3://ondoway-audio/placeholder/ audio can be selected into a Paris tour. Given the dev graph's placeholder beats on Eiffel Tower and Shakespeare and Company, the loaded corpus snapshot excludes them.
